query: 供应商反腐败管理 供应商反腐败管理 衡量企业在供应链环节识别、预防及处置腐败行为的制度化水平。重点考察廉洁协议的法律约束力、针对供应商的背景尽调（Due Diligence）、定期廉洁审计及违规退出机制。 一、内容质量得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（卓越）：合同中包含严厉的反腐败与反贿赂条款（含关联交易穿透）；建立了针对供应商实益拥有人的背景尽调机制；定期开展针对高风险采购环节的专项廉洁审计；具备明确的“黑名单”库及永久终止合作的退出机制。 • 1分（合格）：要求供应商签署标准的廉洁协议或诚信承诺书，具备基础的入驻资质审核，对违规行为有处罚说明，但缺乏深度的背景尽调、主动审计或系统化的退出流程。 • 0分（不合格）：无相关供应商反腐政策披露，或仅有笼统的“商业道德”表述。 二、覆盖应用得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（高覆盖）：反腐败条款签署及尽调机制覆盖 >80% 的活跃供应商（或重点业务领域供应商），且定期进行反腐败宣导培训。 • 1分（部分覆盖）：占比 >0% - 80%，或仅核心/大额采购供应商执行，或未说明具体覆盖比例。 • 0分（无覆盖）：无相关覆盖范围信息。 供应商反腐败 反贿赂条款 廉洁协议 诚信承诺书 供应商尽调 实益拥有人 关联关系申报 利益冲突声明 回扣 廉洁审计 供应商黑名单 因腐败终止合作 反腐败培训 第三方风险管理 supplier anti-corruption anti-bribery clauses integrity agreement supplier due diligence beneficial ownership related-party declaration conflict of interest declaration kickback integrity audit supplier blacklist termination for corruption supplier anti-corruption training third-party risk management 合同是否含反腐败/反贿赂条款及关联交易穿透？ 是否要求供应商申报与员工的亲属、利益或关联关系？ 是否对实益拥有人做背景尽调？ 是否对高风险采购做专项廉洁审计？ 黑名单与退出机制如何运作？ 签署与尽调覆盖多少活跃供应商？ 是否定期开展供应商反腐败宣导培训？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '供应商反腐败管理'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 合同是否含反腐败/反贿赂条款及关联交易穿透？ 是否要求供应商申报与员工的亲属、利益或关联关系？ 是否对实益拥有人做背景尽调？ 是否对高风险采购做专项廉洁审计？ 黑名单与退出机制如何运作？ 签署与尽调覆盖多少活跃供应商？ 是否定期开展供应商反腐败宣导培训？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅有员工反贿赂政策；仅有笼统商业道德；仅有供应商环境审核；仅有行为准则中一笔带过的“禁止行贿”而无尽调退出；区分：供应商反腐败管理聚焦供应链第三方腐败预防与退出；企业反贿赂管理体系更广含员工与商业伙伴；行为准则是综合文本；道德采购还可能包含冲突矿产等人权采购议题。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

For the information received regarding complaints and reports, the Group will analyze and evaluate the reports within five working days to determine whether the conditions for investigation are met. For reports that meet the conditions for investigation, we will i m m e d i a t e l y s e t u p a n i n v e s t i g a t i o n team and carry out investigation work, focus on project companies with a record of fraud in future operation and management audits, and conduct more comprehensive and in-depth management audits on them. In 2021, the Group established audit dispatching branches in Yunnan, Guizhou and Sichuan, and planned the construction of branches in western regions, which greatly increased the audit coverage and further strengthened the supervision function effectively.

results.section: Environmental protection to help maintain ecosystem health
results.text: In 2021, the Group carried out diversified activities on the themes of 'Labor Safety', 'Production Safety Month', 'No Accidents in 100 Successive Days', '119 Harmonious Fire Fighting', 'Safety Knowledge Contest', etc. During these activities, the Group conducted safety training for regional and project l e a d e r s a s w e l l a s r e l e v a n t m a n a g e r s w i t h 3 0 0 participants, held HSE knowledge contests with 12,935 respondents and the short video competitions with 4,223,730 visitors. During the 'Production Safety Month', our subsidiaries organized more than 1,800 safety trainings, covering more than 42,000 persontimes, creating a culture of safety and environmental protection management among the whole workforce and steadily raising employees' awareness of safety and environmental protection.

[Content]
In 2021, the Group carried out diversified activities on the themes of 'Labor Safety', 'Production Safety Month', 'No Accidents in 100 Successive Days', '119 Harmonious Fire Fighting', 'Safety Knowledge Contest', etc. During these activities, the Group conducted safety training for regional and project l e a d e r s a s w e l l a s r e l e v a n t m a n a g e r s w i t h 3 0 0 participants, held HSE knowledge contests with 12,935 respondents and the short video competitions with 4,223,730 visitors. During the 'Production Safety Month', our subsidiaries organized more than 1,800 safety trainings, covering more than 42,000 persontimes, creating a culture of safety and environmental protection management among the whole workforce and steadily raising employees' awareness of safety and environmental protection.
